lines.en: label christmalloween4:
scene nightsky
On the topic of “fate,” I’ve been wondering lately if there’s any merit to it. And how much mental wherewithal would be needed to reach down its throat and retake the even vaguer concept of destiny.
lines.zh: 说到「命运」，我最近一直在想它到底有没有道理。而要想把手伸进它的喉咙、把「宿命」这个更模糊的概念夺回来，又需要多大的心力。

lines.en: I was raised with the notion of winners winning and losers losing wrapped so tightly around my neck that it could be misconstrued as a noose.
lines.zh: 我从小被「赢家赢、输家输」这套观念勒得那么紧，紧到别人可能会把它误认成绞索。

lines.en: And so here I swing and sway, toyed with by the wind in summer’s fall, knowing that what one is raised to think and know is but one more jaded account of a life someone else has lived.
lines.zh: 于是我就在这儿摇来晃去，被夏末的风玩弄于股掌，心里明白：一个人从小被教导去思考和相信的东西，不过是别人活过的一生的又一种厌倦版本。

lines.en: If I am anything, which I often think I’m not, I am me.
lines.zh: 如果我是什么的话——虽然我常觉得自己什么都不是——那我就是我。

lines.en: And if there’s anything I know about myself, which I often think there’s not, it’s that the only person who can choose what becomes of my life is the one living it (me).
lines.zh: 而如果说我对自己有什么了解的话——虽然我常觉得没有——那就是：唯一能决定我人生走向的人，是活出这人生的那个人（我）。

lines.en: Or at least that’s how I felt before I learned about God.
lines.zh: 至少在我知道神的存在之前，我是这么想的。

lines.en: Now, I fear that this life has never been {i}mine{/i} to live at all. And that “fate” is just a fancy word that grown-ups use to describe His plans for us.
lines.zh: 如今我却害怕，这人生从来就不是{i}我{/i}该活的。而「命运」不过是大人们用来描述祂对我们的安排的一个漂亮说法。

lines.en: But I walk among them now — the ones I so gradually grew to detest. I’ve learned to see the forest for the trees.
lines.zh: 可如今我走在他们中间——那些我一点点变得厌恶的人。我学会了从树木之间看见森林。

lines.en: And every single one of them is beautiful.
lines.zh: 而他们每一个都很美。

lines.en: Even those still growing.
lines.zh: 连那些还在生长的也是。

lines.en: scene maturehotel4
: So what’s the plan now, exactly? Did we really only dress up to look hot in front of {i}each other{/i} tonight?
lines.zh: 那么现在到底什么计划？我们今晚穿成这样，真的只是为了在{i}彼此{/i}面前好看吗？

lines.en: : Are you suggesting that we take to the streets to try and seduce people? Or just lure them into potentially believing that we’re still in high school?
lines.zh: 你是建议我们上街去勾引人？还是只是把人骗得以为我们还在上高中？

lines.en: scene maturehotel2
: I’m pretty sure only one of us would be able to pull off the high school thing, so I guess the former if those are the only two options.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定我们里只有一个人装得像高中生，所以如果只有这两个选项，我选前者。

lines.en: : I’m just glad my old uniform still fits. It just comes at the expense of not looking as cougar-ish as you guys.
lines.zh: 我只是高兴旧制服还穿得下。代价就是没你们那么有熟女范儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, which is crazy when you factor in how you had infinitely more sex than both Maki and me {i}combined{/i} in high school.
lines.zh: 是啊，想想你高中时做爱的次数比我和 Maki {i}加起来{/i}还多得多，这就更离谱了。

lines.en: scene maturehotel3
: True. But if we’re ranking ourselves based on current statistics, Maki’s the sex champion here. She’s probably boned more dudes in one day than either of us have in our lives.
lines.zh: 没错。不过要按现在的数据排名，Maki 才是这儿的性爱冠军。她一天睡的男人大概比我们俩这辈子加起来还多。

lines.en: : To be fair, though, it’s not like our numbers in that department are all that impressive. Excluding Maki, obviously.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，我们在这方面的数字也没多值得炫耀。当然，Maki 除外。

lines.en: : Maki, how many guys {i}have{/i} you slept with exactly?
lines.zh: Maki，你到底{i}跟{/i}多少个男人睡过？

lines.en: : Who cares? All that matters is I am winning.
lines.zh: 谁在乎？重要的是我在赢。

lines.en: : With a body like that, it’s kind of hard to lose.
lines.zh: 就这身材，想输都难。

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s a shame we’re the only ones who get to see it.
lines.zh: 是啊。可惜只有我们几个能看到。

lines.en: scene maturehotel4
: Well, Akira’s around, isn’t he? We could always go rile him up and take bets on which one of us he jerks off to later. That’s what Christmalloween is all about, right?
lines.zh: 话是这么说，Akira 不是在这儿吗？我们可以去撩他，然后下注猜他待会儿会对着我们中的谁打飞机。圣诞万圣节不就图这个吗，对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe the Malloween part, sure. I don’t know if he’s here yet, though. I went over there earlier to say hi and it was just the two lady-teachers.
lines.zh: 万圣那部分大概吧。不过我不知道他来了没有。我刚才过去打了个招呼，只有那两位女老师在。

lines.en: : We could take bets on which of {i}them{/i} will masturbate to us? Rin’s mom is a hardcore lesbian at the very least.
lines.zh: 那我们也可以下注猜{i}她们{/i}中谁会对着我们自慰？至少 Rin 的妈妈是个铁杆蕾丝边。

lines.en: scene maturehotel5
: Is she? I thought she was bi?
lines.zh: 是吗？我还以为她是双性恋？

lines.en: : She’d be forced to choose a side if we swarmed her. And we all know which side it would be with your teenage appeal, Maki’s goddess body, and my...{i}intellect.{/i}
lines.zh: 要是我们一拥而上，她就不得不选边站了。而我们都知道她会选哪边——你有少女的魅力，Maki 有女神的身材，而我……有{i}智慧{/i}。

lines.en: : Is that what the kids are calling boobs these days?
lines.zh: 现在的孩子们管奶子叫这个了？

lines.en: : Kids are doing all sorts of stuff nowadays that never would have worked when we were younger.
lines.zh: 现在的孩子们什么花样都来，我们年轻那会儿根本行不通。

lines.en: scene maturehotel6
: Like what? They don’t seem that different to me. Like...we’re not {i}that{/i} old.
lines.zh: 比如什么？我觉得他们也没那么不一样啊。就是……我们又没{i}那么{/i}老。

lines.en: : Sure. But Christmalloween costumes in general are way more revealing now than they were back when {i}we{/i} were in school. Isn’t that kind of dangerous?
lines.zh: 是吗。不过现在的圣诞万圣节服装整体比{i}我们{/i}上学那会儿暴露多了。这不太危险吗？

lines.en: : I feel like at least a quarter of those costumes were purchased directly from your store.
lines.zh: 我觉得那些服装里至少有四分之一是直接在你店里买的。

lines.en: : Why’s it dangerous? Aren’t you the one who’s always preaching about sexual positivity and whatnot? Let the girls have their fun.
lines.zh: 有什么危险的？你不就是那个整天宣讲性积极什么的吗？让姑娘们开心一下嘛。

lines.en: scene maturehotel7
: I’m just saying there needs to be a line {i}somewhere,{/i} right? Like, if Makoto went out wearing the same outfit I am, I can’t say I’d be happy about it.
lines.zh: 我只是说总得在{i}什么地方{/i}画条线，对吧？比如说，要是 Makoto 穿着我这身出门，我可不敢说自己会高兴。

lines.en: : If Makoto went out wearing the same outfit you are, it’d probably just fall off. You’re kind of leagues ahead of her in the proportions department.
lines.zh: 要是 Makoto 穿着你这身出门，大概会直接滑下来。你在身材比例上可比她高了好几个档次。

lines.en: : I think I get what Maki’s saying. I’m not really sure if I agree with it, though.
lines.zh: 我觉得我懂 Maki 的意思。不过我不确定自己同不同意。

lines.en: scene maturehotel8
: Yeah, easy for {i}you{/i} to say when you literally never have to worry about it. We’ve all seen your daughter’s costumes.
lines.zh: 是啊，{i}你{/i}当然说得轻松，你根本不用操心这个。我们都见过你女儿的服装。

lines.en: scene maturehotel9
: What’s this about my costumes?
lines.zh: 我的服装怎么了？

lines.en: : See?! You literally couldn’t get further away from {i}revealing{/i} if you tried!
lines.zh: 瞧？！你那身再怎么努力也跟{i}暴露{/i}扯不上关系！

lines.en: : What are you talking about?! You can see her entire arms! At least up until the point where they become steel claws.
lines.zh: 你在说什么？！她的整条胳膊都露着呢！至少在它们变成钢爪之前是露着的。

lines.en: : Makoto told me that Chika girl’s costume a few years ago was literally just bandages. We can at least agree {i}that{/i} is excessive, right?
lines.zh: Makoto 跟我说，几年前那个叫 Chika 的女孩的服装干脆就是绷带。至少{i}那个{/i}算过分吧，我们能达成一致吧？

lines.en: : I think that entirely depends on the amount of bandages. I still don’t really think it’s a problem, though. They’re just costumes, Maki.
lines.zh: 我觉得这完全取决于绷带用了多少。不过我还是不觉得这有什么问题。那只是服装而已，Maki。

lines.en: : Oh...I think I understand what this conversation is about now...
lines.zh: 哦……我好像明白这段对话到底在聊什么了……

lines.en: scene maturehotel10
: Sana, how do {i}you{/i} feel about the revealing nature of some of your friends’ costumes? What’s the teenage perspective on this? Maybe we’re just old.
lines.zh: Sana，{i}你{/i}怎么看有些朋友穿得那么暴露？青少年对这事是什么看法？也许是我们老了。

lines.en: : To be honest...I feel like most of them only dress that way to try and get Sensei’s attention...
lines.zh: 说实话……我觉得她们大多数人那么穿，只是为了吸引 Sensei 的注意……

lines.en: : See, {i}that.{/i} That’s weird. He’s an adult. It’s one thing to have a crush on him, but taking their clothes off to try and appeal to him is a completely different story.
lines.zh: 瞧，{i}就是这个{/i}。这才奇怪。他是个成年人。暗恋他是一回事，可为了讨好他脱衣服就完全是另一回事了。

lines.en: : They don’t know what he’s been through. And forcing him into a situation where he suddenly needs to fend off a swarm of half-naked teenagers has gotta be overwhelming for the poor guy.
lines.zh: 她们不知道他经历过什么。把他逼到突然得招架一群半裸的青少年，对那个可怜人来说肯定很难招架。

lines.en: : But if they like being looked at that way...why is it a problem, exactly?...
lines.zh: 可如果她们喜欢被人那样看……那到底为什么是问题？……

lines.en: : I think Maki’s saying it’s more of a problem because of the situation it puts Sensei in.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Maki 是说，问题在于这把 Sensei 置于什么样的处境。

lines.en: scene maturehotel11
: Well...no. I think. Maybe? Blaming the girls for turning on a grown man sounds like it could get me cancelled.
lines.zh: 嗯……不是。我觉得吧。也许？把责任推到勾引成年男人的女孩身上，听起来会让我被网暴。

lines.en: : I just think that maybe we should be a little less lenient when it comes to what we let our children wear for Christmalloween. That’s all.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得，也许我们在允许孩子穿什么过圣诞万圣节这件事上该稍微严格一点。就这些。

lines.en: : Like, Makoto’s costumes are never {i}that{/i} risque but {i}she’s{/i} still cute.
lines.zh: 比如，Makoto 的服装从来没{i}那么{/i}大胆，可{i}她{/i}还是可爱。

lines.en: : Right! Same as Sana.
lines.zh: 对！Sana 也一样。

lines.en: scene maturehotel12
: Sana’s costumes are definitely {i}something,{/i} alright. I’m not sure if “cute” is the word I’d use to describe them, though.
lines.zh: Sana 的服装确实{i}挺有说头{/i}的。不过我不确定我会用「可爱」来形容。

lines.en: : It’s just one day out of the year, Maki. I think it’s a {i}good{/i} thing that we give the girls this much freedom.
lines.zh: 一年也就这么一天，Maki。我觉得给女孩们这么多自由是件{i}好{/i}事。

lines.en: scene maturehotel13
: Okay. Well, A — you don’t have a kid and don’t have to worry about this. And B — it’s {i}not{/i} just one day. Teenagers are dressing more provactively {i}all the time{/i} now.
lines.zh: 好吧。第一——你没孩子，不用操这个心。第二——这{i}不止{/i}是一天。现在的青少年{i}成天{/i}都穿得越来越挑逗。

lines.en: : Even their uniforms are getting kind of skimpy compared to what we wore. Are you saying you’re just totally cool with that too?
lines.zh: 连校服都比我们那会儿的来得省布料。你是说你连这个也完全无所谓？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. Times change. And I kind of figured you’d be on the side of giving girls the freedom to dress how they want since you have no qualms with literally {i}letting them sell porn.{/i}
lines.zh: 我是说……是啊。时代变了。而且我还以为你会站在「让女孩想穿什么就穿什么」这边，毕竟你连{i}让她们卖色情片{/i}都毫无心理负担。

lines.en: scene maturehotel14
: In a {i}controlled environment{/i} where I know I can keep them safe and educate them, sure! That’s way different than Makoto flashing her panties to some old guy at a train station.
lines.zh: 那是在{i}可控的环境{/i}里，我知道自己能保护她们、教育她们，当然可以！这跟 Makoto 在火车站对着某个老头掀内裤完全是两码事。

lines.en: : Sana, cover your ears. I did that once.
lines.zh: Sana，捂住耳朵。这事我干过一次。

lines.en: : You...didn’t give me enough time to cover my ears...
lines.zh: 你……都没给我时间捂耳朵……

lines.en: scene maturehotel15
: {i}You’re{/i} indifferent to all of this too then? Even as a mother?
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}对这一切也无所谓了？哪怕身为母亲？

lines.en: : You’re not afraid of Sana getting lured into the same situation {i}you{/i} had to go through because she caught the eye of some predator?
lines.zh: 你不怕 Sana 因为被某个捕食者盯上，而被引进{i}你{/i}当年经历过的同一种处境？

lines.en: : Should I...leave the room for this?...
lines.zh: 我是不是……该回避一下？……

lines.en: : No, you can stay. You’re mature enough to hear this. Just like Makoto’s mature enough to sell dildos and fleshlights and pursue whoever she wants regardless of their age.
lines.zh: 不，你可以留下。你已经够成熟，听得懂这些。就像 Makoto 也够成熟，能卖假阳具和飞机杯、能不管对方年龄去追任何人。

lines.en: scene maturehotel16
: That’s crazy! She’s still in high school!
lines.zh: 这太离谱了！她还在上高中呢！

lines.en: : High schoolers just aren’t the same anymore, Maki. I deal with them every single day.
lines.zh: 现在的高中生跟以前不一样了，Maki。我每天都跟他们打交道。

lines.en: : Like, you’d be shocked to hear how sexually active some of these girls are. It’s like there are Saras all over the place now.
lines.zh: 就说吧，你要是知道有些女生有多性活跃，肯定会被吓到。现在简直到处都是 Sara 这样的人。

lines.en: scene maturehotel17
: It’s different when it’s with {i}each other{/i} than it is with people our age. Like, surely {i}you{/i} wouldn’t hook up with a teenager if one started putting the moves on you, right?
lines.zh: 她们{i}互相之间{/i}那是一回事，跟我们这个年纪的人就完全不同了。比如说，{i}你{/i}肯定不会跟一个主动勾引你的青少年搞在一起吧，对吧？

lines.en: if harukasex == False:
: Of course not. But we shouldn’t be punishing teenagers over the actions of the small minority of adults who {i}would.{/i} Right, Sara?
lines.zh: 当然不会。可我们不该因为那一小撮{i}会{/i}这么做的成年人的行为，就去惩罚青少年。对吧，Sara？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah? Maybe? Like...you can’t punish someone {i}before{/i} they do anything wrong.
lines.zh: 呃……对吧？也许？就是……你不能在人{i}还没{/i}做错事之前就惩罚人家。

lines.en: scene maturehotel18
: This is {i}protection{/i} we’re talking about. Not punishment.
lines.zh: 我们说的是{i}保护{/i}，不是惩罚。

lines.en: : I’m fine with girls expressing themselves however they want until they start going around and trying to bait older guys into having sex with them. That, I feel the need to step in for.
lines.zh: 女孩想怎么表达自己都行，我无所谓——直到她们开始到处勾引年纪更大的男人跟她们上床。到那一步，我觉得自己必须出面。

lines.en: else:
: If I said I would, then what?
lines.zh: 如果我说我会呢？那又怎样？

lines.en: : Then I’d say you’re a disgusting piece of shit who shouldn’t be allowed in public. That’s what.
lines.zh: 那我就会说你是个恶心的狗东西，根本不该被放出来见人。就是这样。

lines.en: scene maturehotel19
: Woah. Isn’t that a little excessive, Maki? Haruka’s trying to be civil about this.
lines.zh: 哇哦。这有点过分了吧，Maki？Haruka 只是在试着好好讲道理。

lines.en: : {i}Civil?{/i} About having sex with high schoolers? Sorry Sara, but I’m not going to be civil about this. You guys aren’t going to make {i}me{/i} feel like the weird one here.
lines.zh: {i}讲道理？{/i}跟高中生上床这种事也要讲道理？抱歉啊 Sara，这事我没法讲道理。你们别想让{i}我{/i}觉得自己才是这里那个奇怪的人。

lines.en: scene maturehotel20
: So yeah. If you went out and fucked some innocent student just because their hormones compelled them to do something stupid, you sure as hell wouldn’t be {i}my{/i} friend anymore.
lines.zh: 所以没错。要是你因为某个无辜学生的荷尔蒙让他们干了蠢事，就跑去跟人家上床，那你绝对不再是{i}我{/i}的朋友了。

lines.en: : Hope that answers your question.
lines.zh: 希望这回答了你的问题。

lines.en: : Yeah...I really feel like I shouldn’t have been here for this...
lines.zh: 是啊……我真觉得自己不该在这儿听这些……

lines.en: scene maturehotel21
: No, no. You’re fine, baby. Just maybe don’t tell Makoto her mom is in here freaking out over the current state of Christmalloween costumes among teens.
lines.zh: 不不。你没事的，宝贝。只是别告诉 Makoto 她妈妈在这儿因为青少年圣诞万圣节服装的现状而抓狂就行。

lines.en: : I just...want what’s best for my daughter. That’s all. So I’m sorry if not wanting her sexualized in front of adults is a little conservative for you guys.
lines.zh: 我只是……想给我女儿最好的。就这样。所以，如果不想让她在成年人面前被性化对你们来说有点保守，那我抱歉。

lines.en: : If it makes you happy...Makoto would probably agree...I don’t think she’s a fan of the...um...{i}more revealing{/i} costumes either...
lines.zh: 要是这能让你好受点……Makoto 大概也会同意……我觉得她也不太喜欢那种……嗯……{i}更暴露{/i}的服装……

lines.en: : Thanks, Sana. I needed that.
lines.zh: 谢谢，Sana。我正需要这句话。

lines.en: : Well, don’t get {i}upset!{/i} We don’t need to agree on everything to still have a good time. Right, Haruka?
lines.zh: 好了，别{i}难过{/i}！我们不需要事事一致也能玩得开心。对吧，Haruka？

lines.en: : Uhh...y...yeah...
lines.zh: 呃……是……是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah, we can...just not agree on some stuff and...that doesn’t change anything about anyone.
lines.zh: 是啊，我们可以……在某些事上意见不同……那也不会改变任何人的任何东西。

lines.en: : Until it does.
lines.zh: 直到它真的改变了为止。

lines.en: scene black
: And then you hate yourself for never noticing it was coming.
lines.zh: 然后你会恨自己，因为从来没察觉到它正在逼近。

lines.en: scene maturehotel22
: You know, Rika — I’ve gotta say...I’m proud of these girls. This is probably the least revealing Christmalloween we’ve had yet.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，Rika——我得说……我替这些女孩骄傲。这大概是我们办过的最不暴露的一次圣诞万圣节了。

lines.en: : Yeah...But I still can’t help but feel like there’s someone out there currently talking about how messed up the current state of Christmalloween costumes is as a whole.
lines.zh: 是啊……可我还是忍不住觉得，这会儿外面正有人在感慨圣诞万圣节服装的整体现状有多糟糕。

lines.en: : You’re probably only saying that because I keep having to tell you your thong is showing.
lines.zh: 你大概只是因为我不停提醒你丁字裤露出来了，才这么说的吧。

lines.en: scene maturehotel23
: If any of these girls have any intrusive thoughts about the thong of a forty-two year old woman, that’s on them. Not me.
lines.zh: 要是这些女孩里有人对一个四十二岁女人的丁字裤产生什么不该有的想法，那是她们的问题。不是我的。

lines.en: : And also Makoto’s mom since I bought this from her store and I’m pretty sure this dress is one size smaller than it was supposed to be.
